scope: R0102-R0113 whole demhndl.c and coupled acquisition bodies. Single-agent initial and counter-review.
metric: Original-relative added+removed lines, newline normalized and #line excluded; includes unchanged excluded bodies. Source line count is not used.
initial_review: Old durable-pointer comments and lease cleanup dependencies were not original-failure proof. Trace handle.asm ReadSetup -> Align_Buffer -> HRDSVC DEMREAD/DEMWRITE and dev.asm one-byte device path; application buffer is variable, unlike fixed DOSDATA error record.
counter_review: DOS segment-fit guard does not imply physically contiguous CCPU page mappings. SIM32 translates only the first linear byte with c_GetLinAdd; ordinary native I/O uses consecutive host bytes. Sim32FlushVDMPointer copies video scratch only for video addresses and c_sas_overwrite_memory is a no-op in CCPU, so it cannot scatter a RAM buffer.

actual_counterexample.case: DS:DX 9000:0FFE, length4, low linear pages90/91 mapped to distinct nonadjacent physical pages. Original Sim32pGetVDMPointer + contiguous4-byte access returns wrong suffix; current real SAS/session copy returns33445566. Page table restored and CR3 reloaded afterward.
actual_counterexample.limits: Fixture configures valid mappings; no claim a production guest application reproduced this layout or failure. It demonstrates the supported arbitrary-buffer address contract, not asynchronous lifetime or failure-partial-write equivalence.
